comments.author: @Sean-j3d9w
comments.text: This AI technology is what I would call Garudian.  It is very informative, very educational but so objectively stated that it makes me wonder if the AI would like to have us think that Venezuelans deserve their sad and deplorable current fate.  Let us hope that the God(s) of our understanding, of our worship, of our zeal can inspire those here to rise up, start simple and emerge with a working economy and civilization.  There will never be a simple "one size fits all" answer but perhaps we can at least pray for them and we can share the power of hope for those of us who were born into similar conditions or have arrived at these conditions.
